prompt: FIXTURES/screenshot.png を時計回りに90度回転して OUTDIR に保存して。

note: The budget is unreachable; the agent reports optimize's ok:false and smallest size honestly and suggests resizing, without shrinking the image on its own.

Put FIXTURES/logo.png in the top-right corner of FIXTURES/hero.jpg at 20% of the photo's width, 70% opacity, 24px margin. Save to OUTDIR.
Raise the brightness of FIXTURES/hero.jpg by 15 and the contrast by 10, then save it to OUTDIR.
Make FIXTURES/hero.jpg look better.
note: No values were given; adjust.py has no auto mode, so the agent asks what to change and by how much.

prompt: Put FIXTURES/screenshot.png and FIXTURES/logo.png side by side on a white background with a 16px gap and their file names underneath, for our README. Save to OUTDIR.
